_comment: Groq LPU / TSP (GroqChip1) single-accelerator HAT twin. NO HBM: 220 MiB (230 MB) on-chip globally-shared SRAM is the ONLY device memory and serves as the backing tier (role:sram). Weights resident on-chip; deterministic dataflow, no caches/arbiters -> no HBM spill cliff. Numbers: Groq GroqChip Product Spec Sheet v1.5 + Think Fast ISCA 2020 TSP paper + third-party teardowns (codingconfessions/aiwiki).
arch_note: no HBM; on-chip resident state -- 220 MiB (230,686,720 B) global SRAM is the sole device memory (backing role:sram); weights resident on-chip; deterministic streaming dataflow.

provenance.source: Capacity GOLD: Groq Spec Sheet v1.5 + ISCA 2020 (220 MiB = 230,686,720 B), both verifiers agree, sole device memory. Bandwidth downgraded GOLD->SILVER: vendor 80 TB/s aggregates all concurrent stream lanes; ISCA 2020 paper cites ~27.5 TiB/s internal SRAM BW -- definitional discrepancy. energy_pj_per_byte / line_bytes are BRONZE estimates (see meta.notes).

Stream/vector register staging (SXR) feeding the MXM in the weight-stationary stream; capacity NOT published -- estimated register-file order (~256 KB). ISCA 2020 stream-register description. Present to satisfy backing->reuse->compute 3-level schema; do not treat as a measured C-block cap.

Groq Spec Sheet v1.5 (188 TFLOPS FP16 => device peak 1.88e14 FLOP/s = 9.4e13 MAC/s x1x2; 750 TOPS INT8; 900 MHz) + ISCA 2020 (320x320 MXM, weight-stationary). SILVER: 188 TFLOPS is labeled FP16 not native BF16 (MXM accumulates FP32); per_instance_mac_s 9.4e13 sits ~2% above the 320x320x900MHz=9.216e13 derivation (2 E/W MXM slices aggregate). instances=1 (single effective matrix engine) modeling choice. vector_alus 5120 upgraded to GOLD via ISCA corroboration but non-load-bearing.

meta.arch_note: no HBM; 220 MiB on-chip SRAM sole device memory; no spill cliff
meta.notes: tdp_w DISPUTED: authored 215W = Groq Spec Sheet v1.5 chip-level (TDP 215W / Max 300W / Avg 185W); adversarial re-search found GroqCard board ~240W avg / 375W peak and ~300W TDP elsewhere and could not reproduce 215W -> downgraded GOLD->BRONZE, kept as chip-level figure. tdp is non-load-bearing (does not affect twin tier).
